headline: San Francisco Takes Over
caption:
From 4% to 14%. Watch San Francisco climb to the top of the Super Bowl race.

The Niners gained 10 points since Sep 8, the biggest rise of any team, and sit just off their 15% peak. Kansas City climbed 8 points, from 2% to 10%, and Minnesota went from 4% to 10%. Jacksonville is still up from its 6% start, but it has cooled from a 13% peak to 9%. New England sits right where it began at 7%.

Our model simulates the rest of the season and the playoffs thousands of times each day, so every line moves with what happens on the field. Even the favorite misses the Super Bowl far more often than not.

Who makes the next big move?
